Measurable improvements in customer retention and repeat purchases. The essence is simple: leverage AI to make customer engagement more efficient and effective. data.body: Meta's Muse Glimmer is making waves by allowing AI to run on local consumer GPUs, a game-changer for smaller APAC businesses. Running AI locally enhances data privacy and slashes costs, crucial for businesses that can't afford hefty cloud service fees. This open-source model democratizes sophisticated AI tools, making them accessible to businesses of all sizes. At Purands AI, we see this as a pivotal shift. Our retention marketing platform can now leverage these local AI agents to deepen customer engagement without breaking the bank. Imagine having the capability to offer personalized win-back or replenishment strategies while keeping customer data securely in-house. Our AI agents, integrated with CRM and messaging platforms like WhatsApp and Shopify, can predict churn and enhance loyalty programs effectively. By adopting Muse Glimmer, smaller businesses can personalize customer interactions at scale, turning one-time buyers into repeat customers. The key is in the measurable outcomes - reduced churn and increased lifetime value (LTV). It's not just about technology; it's about making it work for your business.
